title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) - 100% Remote
summary: ProviPanda ist ein wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup und mittlerweile die größte Sales-Job-App im DACH-Raum. Mit einem Team aus 15 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten wir daran, den Sales-HR-Markt zu revolutionieren…
description:
ProviPanda ist ein wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup und mittlerweile die größte Sales-Job-App im DACH-Raum. Mit einem Team aus 15 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten wir daran, den Sales-HR-Markt zu revolutionieren und neu zu denken.
Als Customer Success Manager bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere über 200 aktiven Kunden im Tagesgeschäft. Du sorgst dafür, dass sie zufrieden sind, langfristig bei uns bleiben und mit uns wachsen.
Deine Aufgaben
Du führst Onboardings und regelmäßige Check-ins durch und kennst deine Kunden wirklich

Du hilfst bei allen Kundenproblemen, egal ob Support oder Success, und bleibst dran, bis sie gelöst sind

Du bist erste Ansprechperson für alle Kundenthemen außerhalb von Sales

Du übernimmst Eskalationen und behältst auch bei schwierigen Kunden einen kühlen Kopf

Du entscheidest eigenständig bei Refunds, Kulanzfällen und Zahlungsthemen (Stripe)

Du bindest Kunden langfristig und baust gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team Accounts aus

Du erkennst Upsell-Potenzial im Kundengespräch und gibst es gezielt weiter

Das bringst du mit
Du bist kundenorientiert, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Probleme deiner Kunden

Du hast eine hohe Stressresilienz und bleibst auch in hektischen Phasen souverän

Du hast Fingerspitzengefühl im Umgang mit Menschen, gerade wenn es mal schwierig wird

Du erkennst echtes Potenzial und unterscheidest A-Kunden von C-Kunden, ohne dir etwas vormachen zu lassen

MAOMAO ist ein Online-Supermarkt für asiatische Lebensmittel mit Sitz in Berlin. Wir verbinden E-Commerce mit Content, Community und Social Commerce und erreichen über Kanäle wie TikTok und Instagram eine breite Community. In unseren Livestreams stellen wir Produkte vor, probieren Neues und tauschen uns mit unserer Community aus. Dafür suchen wir dich als Unterstützung vor der Kamera und bei allem, was rund um unsere Lives passiert.
Produktwissen, Präsentation und Verkaufen im Livestream bringen wir dir Schritt für Schritt bei. Wir bereiten die Auftritte gemeinsam vor, stehen zusammen vor der Kamera und coachen dich dabei.

summary: Sie bauen den technischen Vertrieb in Ostdeutschland auf: eigenverantwortlich und in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung. Unser Mandant, ein mittelständisches Industrieunternehmen im…
description:
Sie bauen den technischen Vertrieb in Ostdeutschland auf: eigenverantwortlich und in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung. Unser Mandant, ein mittelständisches Industrieunternehmen im Maschinenbau-Umfeld mit technisch erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, will bei seinen Kunden in Ostdeutschland insgesamt präsenter und mehr vor Ort sein.
Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir vertraulich: Um welches Unternehmen es geht, erfahren Sie vor dem ersten Gespräch, und Ihre Unterlagen geben wir nur mit Ihrer Zustimmung weiter.
Ihre Aufgaben
Sie erschließen das Gebiet mit Schwerpunkt Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Thüringen und Berlin; den genauen Zuschnitt legen wir gemeinsam fest.
Sie gewinnen neue Kunden überwiegend aus eigener Akquise: Sie erkennen, wo Bedarf entsteht, wählen Branchen und Zielunternehmen aus und gehen gezielt darauf zu.
Ihre Gesprächspartner und Gesprächspartnerinnen sitzen in Konstruktion, Entwicklung und Planung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, im Bau und in der Industrie, häufig schon in der Projektphase. Mit ihnen sprechen Sie auf Augenhöhe über Anforderungen und Auslegung und begleiten das Projekt bis zur passenden Lösung.
Sie bringen Ihre Marktbeobachtungen in regelmäßige Runden mit der Zentrale ein, die Sie bei Marktrecherche und Akquisevorbereitung unterstützt.
Wo es bereits Kunden gibt, betreuen Sie diese mit.

summary: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology…
description:
Company Overview
Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.
We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.
What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.
This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.
You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and…

summary: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of…
description:
About Andercore
Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.
Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.
We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.
We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.
Where we are today:
Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

Seven European markets…

WHO WE ARE
Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. description:
Overview

We're looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology.

Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes,…

description:
About us
Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.
Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.
About the role
You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.
Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one.
About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.
We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship.
What you’ll do
Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role.

description:
About Us
We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.
Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.
The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.
Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.
Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix,…

At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above.

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

Join our Product team to shape the future of financial access and infrastructure. We're not just improving global payments—we're reinventing them. Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
